posts.headline: That's it for live coverage tonight
posts.body: 1,430 of 1,431 polls have reported. Olivia Chow is the projected winner for mayor with 54.2%. 25 of 25 council races have a winner or projected winner. The results on this page keep updating from the City's feed. Thanks for following along.

posts.headline: Mike Colle leads as Ward 8 Eglinton-Lawrence completes count
posts.body: In City council, Ward 8 (Eglinton-Lawrence), all 61 polls are reporting. Incumbent Mike Colle has 32,085 votes (70.3%), 27,171 ahead of Liz Grade.

posts.headline: Ausma Malik leads as Ward 10 Spadina-Fort York completes count
posts.body: In City council, Ward 10 (Spadina-Fort York), all 80 of 80 polls are reporting. Incumbent Ausma Malik has 21,975 votes (47.3%), 8,570 ahead of Ian Cunningham at 13,405 (28.9%).

posts.headline: Every poll is in for Ward 1 Etobicoke North: Vincent Crisanti holds on
posts.body: The incumbent finishes first for council with 12,804 votes (45.5%), 8,799 ahead of Ala'a Adib. Unofficial until certified.

posts.body: In City council, Ward 25 (Scarborough-Rouge Park), all 40 of 40 polls are in. Incumbent Neethan Shan has 15,727 votes (44.8%), ahead of Shawn Allen with 9,526 (27.1%).

posts.body: The incumbent finishes first for council with 28,179 votes (66.5%), 16,546 ahead of Marco Martins. Unofficial until certified.

posts.body: Sara Ehrhardt finishes first for council with 22,440 votes (48.8%), 12,015 ahead of Mary Fragedakis. Unofficial until certified.

posts.headline: Teresa Colonna wins TCDSB Ward 10
posts.body: In TCDSB Ward 10, Teresa Colonna wins the school trustee race with 31.1%.

posts.body: The incumbent finishes first for council with 20,305 votes (72.3%), 17,715 ahead of Robert Bazil. Unofficial until certified.

posts.body: Every poll is in. Chiara Padovani tops the council race with 39.1%. Unofficial until certified.

posts.body: Brandon Choi is projected to win TDSB Ward 4 with 42.8%, Karen Emerson is projected to win TDSB Ward 10 with 30.3%, and Maria Rizzo is projected to win TCDSB Ward 5 with 50.8%.

posts.body: In Ward 21 Scarborough Centre, incumbent Michael Thompson has 16,053 votes (51.1%) to Krissan Veerasingam's 4,653 (14.8%), with all 49 polls reporting.

posts.body: In Ward 18 Willowdale, incumbent Lily Cheng has 20,746 votes (63.1%) to David Magazzinich's 6,804 (20.7%), with all 56 polls reporting.

posts.body: In Ward 20 Scarborough Southwest, incumbent Parthi Kandavel finishes with 12,231 votes (36%) to Kevin Rupasinghe's 10,513 (30.9%), with all 61 polls reporting.

posts.headline: Nate Erskine-Smith is projected to win Ward 19 Beaches-East York
posts.body: In Ward 19 Beaches-East York, Nate Erskine-Smith has 21,181 votes (46.9%) to Natalie Johnson's 10,984 (24.3%), with 51 of 53 polls reporting.

posts.body: Farzana Rajwani is projected to win TDSB Ward 8 with 29.2%. Christopher Mammoliti wins TDSB Ward 9 with 37.0%.

posts.headline: Shelley Carroll finishes first in Ward 17 Don Valley North
posts.body: In Ward 17 Don Valley North, all 60 polls are in. Incumbent Shelley Carroll has 19,042 votes (62.0%), 14,912 ahead of Sabrina Zuniga.

posts.body: In Ward 12 Toronto-St. Paul's, all 58 polls are in. Incumbent Josh Matlow has 32,780 votes (67.6%), 23,593 ahead of Jenny Kalimbet.

posts.body: In the mayor's race, 1,309 of 1,431 polls are in. Olivia Chow leads with 490,912 votes (54.0%), 116,304 ahead of Brad Bradford.

posts.body: TDSB Ward 2: Timothy Ellis (projected); TDSB Ward 5: Jennifer Volk (projected); TDSB Ward 7: Deborah Williams (wins); TDSB Ward 11: Ravicha Ravinthiran (projected); TDSB Ward 12: Anu Sriskandarajah (projected); TCDSB Ward 2: Markus de Domenico (projected); TCDSB Ward 4: Teresa Lubinski (projected); TCDSB Ward 7: Marissa Largo (projected); TCDSB Ward 8: Garry Tanuan (projected); TCDSB Ward 9: Jonathan Santos (projected); Viamonde Ward 3: Anna-Karyna Ruszkowski (projected); MonAvenir Ward 3: Yelena Nichilo (projected).

posts.body: The incumbent finishes first for council with 23,434 votes (67.5%), 15,571 ahead of Sheena Sharp. Unofficial until certified.

posts.body: With 95% of polls in, the incumbent has 44.7% of the vote to Shawn Allen's 27.1%. This is the page's own projection from the unofficial count, not an official result.

posts.headline: Shaun Chen projected to unseat Jamaal Myers in Ward 23 Scarborough North
posts.body: With 95% of polls in, Chen has 35.9% to the incumbent's 25.6%. This is the page's own projection from the unofficial count, not an official result.

posts.headline: Nick Mantas re-elected in Ward 22 Scarborough-Agincourt
posts.body: The incumbent has 40.7% of the vote to Bill Chan's 17.4%, a lead that can no longer be overtaken in the unofficial count.

posts.headline: Sara Ehrhardt is projected to win Ward 14
posts.body: In the open Ward 14 Toronto-Danforth race, 94% of polls are in. Sara Ehrhardt has 48.8% of the vote to Mary Fragedakis's 22.7%.

posts.headline: Curran Stikuts is projected to unseat Chris Moise in Ward 13
posts.body: In Ward 13 Toronto Centre, 96% of polls are in. Curran Stikuts has 28.6% of the vote to incumbent Chris Moise's 23.3%.

posts.headline: Ausma Malik is projected to be re-elected in Ward 10
posts.body: In Ward 10 Spadina-Fort York, 98% of polls are in. Incumbent Ausma Malik has 47.6% of the vote to Ian Cunningham's 28.8%.

posts.headline: Diana Chan McNally is projected to win Ward 4
posts.body: In the open Ward 4 Parkdale-High Park race, 97% of polls are in. Diana Chan McNally has 42.3% of the vote to Nadia Guerrera's 27.9%.

posts.headline: Amber Morley is projected to be re-elected in Ward 3
posts.body: In Ward 3 Etobicoke-Lakeshore, 93% of polls are in. Incumbent Amber Morley has 48.4% of the vote to Ted Opitz's 37.1%.

posts.headline: Olivia Chow is projected to be re-elected as mayor
posts.body: In the mayor's race, 87% of polls are in. Incumbent Olivia Chow has 54.0% of the vote to Brad Bradford's 41.2%.

posts.headline: 75% of polls are now in
posts.body: 1,244 of 1,431 polls have reported. Olivia Chow leads for mayor with 54.0%, 112,214 votes ahead of Brad Bradford.

posts.headline: Halfway there: half of all polls have reported
posts.body: 1,244 of 1,431 polls have reported. Olivia Chow leads for mayor with 54.0%, 112,214 votes ahead of Brad Bradford.

posts.headline: Three school trustee candidates are projected to win their races
posts.body: Matias de Dovitiis is projected to win TDSB Ward 1 with 32.3%, Stacey Cline is projected to win TDSB Ward 6 with 57.9%, and Robert Pella is projected to win TCDSB Ward 1 with 45.5%.

posts.headline: Anthony Perruzza finishes first in Ward 7
posts.body: In Ward 7 Humber River-Black Creek, all 45 polls are in. Anthony Perruzza has 15,947 votes, or 66.4%, ahead of Amanda Coombs with 6,097 votes, or 25.4%.

posts.headline: Mike Colle is projected to be re-elected in Ward 8
posts.body: In Ward 8 Eglinton-Lawrence, Mike Colle has 32,078 votes, or 70.3%, with 98% of polls reporting. Liz Grade has 4,912 votes, or 10.8%.

posts.headline: Chiara Padovani is projected to unseat Frances Nunziata in Ward 5
posts.body: In Ward 5 York South-Weston, Chiara Padovani has 12,487 votes, or 39.0%, with 94% of polls reporting. Daniel Di Giorgio has 9,281 votes, or 29.0%.

posts.headline: Stephen Holyday is projected to be re-elected in Ward 2
posts.body: In Ward 2 Etobicoke Centre, Stephen Holyday has 15,151 votes, or 58.8%, with 52% of polls reporting. Katie Andrachuk has 6,865 votes, or 26.6%.

posts.headline: Alexis Dawson is projected to win TDSB Ward 3
posts.body: In the TDSB Ward 3 trustee race, Alexis Dawson is projected to win with 45.3% of the vote.

posts.headline: Mike Layton is projected to win open Ward 11 University-Rosedale seat
posts.body: In City council, Ward 11 University-Rosedale, Mike Layton has 9,259 votes, or 48.5%, with 36% of polls reporting. Diana Yoon has 3,425 votes, or 17.9%.

posts.headline: Alejandra Bravo is projected to be re-elected in Ward 9 Davenport
posts.body: In City council, Ward 9 Davenport, incumbent Alejandra Bravo has 10,539 votes, or 70.6%, with 28% of polls reporting. Marco Martins has 3,490 votes, or 23.4%.

posts.headline: Angela Kennedy is projected to win TCDSB Ward 11
posts.body: In the TCDSB Ward 11 trustee race, Angela Kennedy is the projected winner with 73.9% of the vote.

posts.headline: Josh Matlow is projected to be re-elected in Ward 12 Toronto-St. Paul's
posts.body: In Ward 12 Toronto-St. Paul's, 16 of 58 polls are in. Incumbent Josh Matlow has 14,535 votes, or 66.9%, to Jenny Kalimbet's 4,796, or 22.1%.

posts.headline: James Pasternak is projected to be re-elected in Ward 6 York Centre
posts.body: In Ward 6 York Centre, 14 of 50 polls are in. Incumbent James Pasternak has 9,050 votes, or 74.2%, to Conroy Irving's 2,366, or 19.4%.

posts.headline: 25% of polls are now in
posts.body: 408 of 1,431 polls have reported. Olivia Chow leads for mayor with 52.0%, 36,109 votes ahead of Brad Bradford.

posts.headline: Jon Burnside is projected to be re-elected in Ward 16
posts.body: In Ward 16 Don Valley East, incumbent Jon Burnside has 8,883 votes, or 76.3%, with 18 of 62 polls reporting. Sinan Erdemir has 1,064 votes, or 9.1%.

posts.headline: Rachel Chernos Lin is projected to be re-elected in Ward 15
posts.body: In Ward 15 Don Valley West, incumbent Rachel Chernos Lin has 10,283 votes, or 69.3%, with 14 of 49 polls reporting. Sheena Sharp has 3,066 votes, or 20.7%.

posts.headline: Lily Cheng is projected to be re-elected in Ward 18 Willowdale
posts.body: In Ward 18 Willowdale, incumbent Lily Cheng is projected to be re-elected with 8,634 votes, or 64.7%. David Magazzinich has 2,881 votes, or 21.6%, with 15 of 56 polls reporting.

posts.headline: Rhea Dechaine is projected to win MonAvenir Ward 4
posts.body: In MonAvenir Ward 4, Rhea Dechaine is the projected winner with 74.0% of the vote.

posts.headline: Paul Ainslie is projected to be re-elected in Ward 24
posts.body: In City council, Ward 24 (Scarborough-Guildwood), incumbent Paul Ainslie has 7,364 votes, or 73.4%, with 13 of 48 polls reporting. Robert Bazil has 934 votes, or 9.3%.

posts.headline: Ida Li Preti is projected to win TCDSB Ward 3
posts.body: In the TCDSB Ward 3 trustee race, Ida Li Preti is projected to win with 80.3% of the vote.

posts.headline: Anthony Perruzza is projected to be re-elected in Ward 7
posts.body: In Ward 7 Humber River-Black Creek, Anthony Perruzza has 5,467 votes, or 68.4%, with 15 of 45 polls reporting. Amanda Coombs has 1,946 votes, or 24.4%.

posts.headline: Vincent Crisanti is projected to be re-elected in Ward 1
posts.body: In Ward 1 Etobicoke North, Vincent Crisanti has 1,835 votes, or 41.6%, with 13 of 46 polls reporting. Chloe Brown has 556 votes, or 12.6%.

posts.headline: Olivia Chow moves ahead in the mayor's race
posts.body: In the mayor's race, incumbent Olivia Chow leads with 108,452 votes, or 50.3%, to Brad Bradford's 96,068 votes, or 44.6%, with 187 of 1,431 polls reporting.

posts.headline: Michael Thompson is projected to be re-elected in Ward 21
posts.body: In Ward 21 Scarborough Centre, Michael Thompson is projected to be re-elected with 7,148 votes, or 53.9%. Krissan Veerasingam has 1,842 votes, or 13.9%, with 14 of 49 polls reporting.

posts.headline: Shelley Carroll is projected to be re-elected in Ward 17
posts.body: In City council, Ward 17 (Don Valley North), incumbent Shelley Carroll is projected to win with 7,527 votes, or 65.1%. Sabrina Zuniga has 1,494 votes, or 12.9%, with 15 of 60 polls in.

posts.headline: Results begin in Wards 14 and 19
posts.body: First polls are in from Ward 14 Toronto-Danforth and Ward 19 Beaches-East York. Citywide, 105 of 1,431 polls are reporting.

posts.headline: Results start arriving from 23 more wards
posts.body: First polls are in from Ward 1 Etobicoke North, Ward 2 Etobicoke Centre, Ward 3 Etobicoke-Lakeshore, Ward 4 Parkdale-High Park, Ward 5 York South-Weston, Ward 6 York Centre, Ward 7 Humber River-Black Creek, Ward 8 Eglinton-Lawrence, Ward 9 Davenport, Ward 10 Spadina-Fort York, Ward 11 University-Rosedale, Ward 12 Toronto-St. Paul's, Ward 13 Toronto Centre, Ward 15 Don Valley West, Ward 16 Don Valley East, Ward 17 Don Valley North, Ward 18 Willowdale, Ward 20 Scarborough Southwest, Ward 21 Scarborough Centre, Ward 22 Scarborough-Agincourt, Ward 23 Scarborough North, Ward 24 Scarborough-Guildwood and Ward 25 Scarborough-Rouge Park.

posts.headline: Brad Bradford leads the mayor's race in first results
posts.body: In the mayor's race, 67 of 1,431 polls are reporting. Brad Bradford has 41,531 votes, or 53.6%, ahead of incumbent Olivia Chow with 32,119 votes, or 41.5%.

posts.headline: City expected results around 9 p.m.; none posted yet
posts.body: In a post at 8:53 p.m., the City of Toronto said some voting places still had voters in line, and that unofficial results would begin to be available at approximately 9 p.m. As of 9:12 p.m. none have been posted. They'll appear here as soon as the City publishes them.

posts.headline: Still waiting on the first results from the City
posts.body: The last extended voting place closed at 8:20 p.m., and the City hasn't posted any results yet. This page checks for new numbers every 30 seconds, so results will appear here on their own as soon as the City publishes them. No need to refresh.

posts.headline: Voting extended at 11 locations, so results may take a little longer
posts.body: After earlier disruptions, the City kept 11 voting places open past 8 p.m., the last until 8:20 p.m., in Wards 2, 5, 7, 8, 11, 13 and 16. Results may start arriving later than usual. Details at toronto.ca/elections.

posts.headline: Polls close across Toronto at 8 p.m.
posts.body: Voting ended at 8 p.m. The first unofficial results are expected to start arriving from the City shortly.

posts.headline: Thirty minutes until polls close
posts.body: Voting is open until 8 p.m. Once polls close, updates will appear here as the City reports results.

posts.headline: One hour until polls close
posts.body: Voting is open until 8 p.m. There are 53 names on the ballot for mayor, and 190 running for council.

posts.headline: Two hours until polls close
posts.body: Voting is open until 8 p.m. Results will start appearing here after 8 p.m., ward by ward, as the City reports them.

posts.headline: Three hours until polls close
posts.body: Voting is open until 8 p.m. 190 candidates are running for council across 25 wards, plus 29 school trustee races.

posts.headline: Four hours until polls close
posts.body: Voting is open until 8 p.m. 2,143,771 people are on the voters' list, choosing a mayor from 53 candidates.
